newsitem.title: USA: Lira ERM re-entry easier after new budget-Ciampi.
newsitem.headline: Lira ERM re-entry easier after new budget-Ciampi.

text.p: Italy's Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi on Saturday confirmed his government's intention to bring the lira back into Europe's Exchange Rate Mechanism.
He added that the task was made easier by the 60 trillion lira budget package the government approved Friday.
The lira's re-entry "has been and is in Italy's intentions. It will be made easier by the passage (of the budget plan)," Ciampi told a press conference.

"The exact timing of the re-entry has yet to be decided. We will have to see at what point of the discussion by parliament of the 1997 budget bill it can be made, and under what conditions," Ciampi explained after the meeting of Group of Seven nations officials.
"The passage (of the budget bill) yesterday is one of the conditions for the re-entry," Ciampi said.
